# Quality tools for the gate's own Python code: Ruff and mypy, run in CI only.
#
# tools/check_repo.py and tests/ use only the standard library and need none
# of this. These two tools check that code, so I pin them exactly, with their
# full dependency closure, and hash-lock every wheel. A file replaced upstream
# under the same version number then fails the install instead of running.
#
# Install with:
#
#   python3 -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: \
#       -r tools/requirements-quality-ci.txt
#
# --only-binary=:all: refuses source distributions, so no build step runs.
# Each pin lists the SHA-256 of every wheel PyPI publishes for that version,
# so the same file installs on every supported Python and platform.
#
# To update a pin, change the version and replace all of its hashes with the
# wheel digests PyPI reports for that release
# (https://pypi.org/pypi/<package>/<version>/json), then run both tools.
# Dependabot proposes these updates.
#
# Configuration for both tools lives in pyproject.toml.
